entities.summary: Andre Devalle Turner is an American former professional basketball player who played in the National Basketball Association (NBA). He is currently on the basketball staff at Memphis after three seasons as head coach at Lane College. A 5'11", 177 lb (80 kg) point guard, he played collegiately at Memphis State University. Born in Memphis, Tennessee, his nickname in college was the "Little General".
